content: We need to identify elements based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns to see which elements show characteristic patterns (e.g., Cl with 3:1 ratio, Br with 1:1, S with M+2 ~4% etc). We need to retrieve isotopic distribution to compare. So steps: call mass_spectrometry_spectra, then retrieve_isotope_distribution. Then manually inspect peaks to see patterns. Let's get spectrum.
